claims.claim: All-arity nonnegative Walsh permutation-cycle XOR representation
Positive zero-pair recurrence transfers canonical-port obstructions to all n>=3
No nonnegative ferromagnetic binary-spin gadget on canonical ports or any two-bit incoming/outgoing pattern encoding

claims.claim: Fhat3 is not windable; no circuit wholly of windable primitives or nonnegative matching circuit
Fhat3 fails planar matchgate MGI in all terminal orders, including signed/complex weights
Exact local value oracle has at most (n+1)^4 states and polynomial worst-case bit cost
Row-factorial denominator Walsh factor has a negative entry already at m=2
n=2 is also nonwindable but has a restricted global Ising FPRAS
claims.limits: Representation obstruction is not approximation hardness
